title: Reception Details
description: Close work from several receptions, where most of the design actually lives. A draped sweetheart table lit with lanterns and pillar candles; freestanding floral pedestals in eucalyptus and white lily; a tall pedestal centrepiece over teal linen; a twine-wrapped wine bottle standing in as a table number; a fishbowl and starfish centrepiece on navy; and flowers frozen into a block of ice for a drinks table.

alt.draped-sweetheart-table-lanterns.jpg: A sweetheart table under white draping with greenery garland, wooden lanterns, pillar candles, and a monogram sign
alt.floral-pedestal-columns.jpg: A freestanding wooden pedestal topped with white lilies, burgundy blooms, and eucalyptus beside a draped ceremony backdrop
alt.tall-floral-pedestal-centerpiece.jpg: A tall wooden lantern centrepiece with a white and burgundy floral crown, over teal napkins and blue linen
alt.wine-bottle-table-number.jpg: A twine-wrapped wine bottle and dried floral arrangement on a wood slice, beside a carved wooden table number reading eight
alt.fishbowl-centerpiece-navy-linen.jpg: A glass fishbowl centrepiece with aquatic greenery and a starfish, set on cheesecloth over a navy tablecloth
alt.candle-and-floral-vignette.jpg: A row of pillar candles among greenery, dried grasses, and white and purple florals in tall glass vessels
alt.floating-florals-in-ice.jpg: White and blush blooms frozen into a block of ice in a gold-rimmed drinks tub
